description: Explore documented stećci and create 2D designs, orbitable 3D forms, or voxel-carved stone models.

store.tagline: Explore real stećci, read inscriptions and design a stone of your own.
store.description: A source-linked introduction to medieval stećci: explore regional distribution, credited photographs, necropolis records, and historically cautious notes on belief, motifs, inscriptions and stoneworking. In the design studio, compose a 2D keepsake, an orbitable 3D design, or a voxel-carved stone. The voxel carver supports 1 cm hand and motif cuts, surface painting, Latin block-letter inscriptions, and STL export. Digital ageing remains available in the 2D designer. This is an educational creative tool, not a scholarly text edition or archaeological reconstruction.
